tldr: 聯準會升息預期與美債殖利率飆升壓抑美股、推升美元，新台幣連假前貶至31.78元。
玉山金確認注資三商壽160億元（9/29基準日），鴻海則擬出清Figure金融科技持股實現利益。
外資8月罕見淨拋售亞洲債券，前雷曼交易員警告殖利率飆升重演1987情境，提醒債券配置審慎。

items.title_zh: 鴻海擬出清美國金融科技公司Figure持股 實現投資利益
items.title_en: Foxconn to Divest US Fintech Figure Technology Stake to Realize Gains
items.summary_zh: 鴻海(2317-TW)代子公司HCM International公告，董事會決議出清所持美國金融科技公司Figure Technology Solutions(FIGR-US)約263萬股，處分目的為實現投資利益，實際價格與總金額待處分後另行公告。此舉反映鴻海調節非核心財務投資、落袋為安，並將資本集中投入AI伺服器與電動車等主軸業務，短線亦挹注業外收益。
items.summary_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) said its board, acting through subsidiary HCM International, resolved to sell all 2.63 million shares it holds in US fintech Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR-US) to lock in investment profits. The final price and total proceeds will be disclosed after execution. The move trims non-core financial holdings and books a gain as the group refocuses capital on its AI-server and EV strategy.

items.title_zh: 騰勢IPO上櫃案再闖一關 前八月營收年增10.61%
items.title_en: Health-Supplement Maker Tengshi Clears Another OTC Listing Hurdle
items.summary_zh: 人體及寵物保健食品開發商騰勢(7889-TW)上櫃申請案獲櫃買中心董監聯席會通過，再過一關。公司2026年8月營收6967萬元，月減5.49%、年減1.36%；1至8月累計營收6.02億元，年增10.61%。營運穩健成長支撐掛牌進度，也為台股保健食品新兵增添資本市場能見度。
items.summary_en: Tengshi (7889-TW), a developer of human and pet health supplements, won approval from Taiwan's OTC board of directors, advancing its listing application. The company posted August revenue of NT$69.67 million (-5.49% MoM, -1.36% YoY) and Jan–Aug revenue of NT$602 million, up 10.61% YoY. The clearance keeps its emerging-stock debut on track amid steady top-line growth.

items.title_zh: 廣積推IB966單板電腦 整合CPU/GPU/NPU搶攻邊緣AI
items.title_en: Giant Integration Launches Panther Lake Single-Board Computer for Edge AI
items.summary_zh: 工業電腦廠廣積(8050-TW)推出高效能IB966 3.5吋單板電腦，搭載Intel Core Ultra 7系列(Panther Lake平台)，於單一平台整合CPU、GPU與NPU運算資源，最高可提供180 TOPS整體AI算力，鎖定邊緣端即時推理、機器視覺、資料分析與工業自動化。廣積藉此切入高成長的邊緣AI硬體市場，強化產品差異化與接單動能。
items.summary_en: Industrial-PC maker Giant Integration (8050-TW) unveiled its IB966 3.5-inch single-board computer built on Intel's Core Ultra 7 (Panther Lake) platform, combining CPU, GPU and NPU on one board with up to 180 TOPS of AI compute. It targets real-time edge inference, machine vision, data analytics and factory automation, positioning Giant in the fast-growing edge-AI hardware race.

items.title_zh: 國喬轉型高值化 鏈結日商AWI布局半導體材料供應鏈
items.title_en: Grand Pacific Petrochemical Pivots Toward Semiconductor Materials via AWI Tie-Up
items.summary_zh: 面對高油價及全球貿易流向重塑，國喬(1312-TW)總經理曾嘉雄表示，公司積極調整營運策略，將轉型投資與產品高值化列為重點，除優化本業外，亦布局高科技及半導體材料產業。今年與日本工業氣體大廠愛沃特(AWI)策略合作，將成為國喬連結半導體材料供應鏈的關鍵布局，分散石化景氣循環風險、開拓成長新動能。
items.summary_en: Facing high oil prices and shifting trade flows, Grand Pacific Petrochemical (Guo Qiao, 1312-TW) said it is transforming its strategy toward high-value products and semiconductor materials. A strategic partnership signed this year with Japanese industrial-gas major AWI (Air Water Inc.) will anchor its entry into the semiconductor-materials supply chain, diversifying beyond its cyclical petrochemical core.

items.title_zh: 玉山金首波注資三商壽160億元 現增基準日定9/29
items.title_en: E.Sun Financial to Inject NT$16 Billion into Newly Acquired Sanshang Life
items.summary_zh: 玉山金控(2884-TW)公告，旗下三商美邦人壽私募現金增資基準日訂於9月29日，發行總額新台幣160億元、7.8億股，每股約20.51元，由母公司100%認購。董事長黃男州指出，2027年將再注資60億元，且無須向股東增資。此為玉山金購併三商壽後首波資本挹注，強化壽險子公司資本適足與後續整合動能。
items.summary_en: E.Sun Financial Holding (2884-TW) said its life-insurance unit Sanshang Mercuries Life will complete a NT$16 billion private-placement capital increase, with the base date set for Sept 29. E.Sun will subscribe 100% of the 780 million new shares at about NT$20.51 each. Chairman Joseph Huang flagged a further NT$6 billion injection in 2027, to be funded without tapping shareholders.

items.title_zh: 〈台幣〉連假前觀望轉貶 收31.78元、貶6.4分
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Slips Before Holiday, Closing at 31.78
items.summary_zh: 新台幣周四一度升值，但全日多處貶勢，反映連假前資金流入動能轉趨觀望，終場收31.78元、貶值6.4分，台北外匯經紀成交值略擴大至18.41億美元。美元因Fed升息預期升溫、公債殖利率走高而走強，壓抑亞幣表現。台幣後市仍受美元強勢與連假前資金調度牽動，短線區間偏弱整理。
items.summary_en: The New Taiwan dollar spent most of Thursday on the back foot, briefly firming before ending down 0.064 at 31.78 per US dollar as pre-holiday fund flows turned cautious. Turnover at Taipei brokers widened slightly to US$1.841 billion. A firmer US dollar — driven by rising Fed rate-hike expectations and higher yields — kept the local unit under mild pressure.

items.title_zh: 亞洲債市8月罕見遭外資淨拋售 學者：全球現象波及
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Turn Net Sellers of Asian Bonds in August, First Outflow in Months
items.summary_zh: 監管機構與債券市場協會數據顯示，8月外資由買轉賣減持亞洲債券，為5個月來首見單月淨流出，打破先前資金持續湧入亞債的格局。學者指出，這是美債殖利率走高帶動的全球資金再定價現象。對持有亞洲及新興市場債券的高資產客戶而言，須重新檢視存續期間與匯率風險，並留意債券資產配置的調整時點。
items.summary_en: Regulator and bond-association data show overseas investors flipped from buyers to sellers of Asian bonds in August, the first monthly net outflow in five months and a break from the region's steady inflows. Analysts call it part of a global repricing as US yields climb — a signal for high-net-worth holders of Asian and emerging-market fixed income to reassess duration and currency risk.

items.title_zh: 債券也能賺得像股票 前雷曼交易員示警「1987股災前兆」
items.title_en: Bonds Now Yield Like Stocks, Ex-Lehman Trader Warns of '1987 Echo'
items.summary_zh: 前雷曼兄弟交易員麥唐納(Larry McDonald)指出，債券殖利率飆升使債券開始提供「媲美股票的報酬」，資金恐由股市轉向債市，情境類似1987年股災前夕。對財富管理客戶而言，此環境提升高評級債券與結構型收益商品的吸引力，但若利率續揚，須慎防股市無序重新定價帶來的資產波動風險。
items.summary_en: Former Lehman Brothers trader Larry McDonald warns that surging bond yields are starting to deliver "stock-like returns," drawing capital away from equities and echoing conditions before the 1987 crash. For wealth clients the shift lifts the appeal of high-grade bonds and structured yield products, but also raises the risk of a disorderly equity repricing if rates keep climbing.
